title: Grateful Dead Live at Southern Star Amphitheater on 1985-08-30
lineage: Master Audience Cassettes> Nakamichi Dragon> Kind Kables RCA/XLR> Lunatec V3 (@ 24/96)> coax> Audiophile 2496> WaveLab 5.0 (edit/mastering)>  .wav @ 24/96 > TLH > FLAC24
source: (FOB) 2 x Sennheiser 441 > Sony D5 > Sony D5 > 2 x Maxell MX 90 (MAC)

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear front‑of‑house recording captures a terrific show highlighted by a soaring Drum > Space segment and a beautiful Wheel jam.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the exceptionally clean and crisp sound, noting fine instrument separation that makes the band feel right there. The performance is praised for its powerful drums‑>space excursion, an inspired Wheel jam, and a standout Bird Song in the first set.

ai_rating.rationale: Two enthusiastic 5‑star reviews emphasize both superb recording quality and strong musical moments, yielding a near‑top rating despite limited sample size.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as extremely clean, crisp, with fine separation of instruments; feels like the band is 'right there'.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Review highlights a tight first‑set jam (Bird Song) and an especially powerful second‑set drum/space segment leading into a beautiful Wheel improvisation.

band_member_comments.Drums: Terrific drumming noted, especially the Drum > Space sequence.
